policy.mandatory_only: Exclude only the explicit optional pixels in the prior review; retain mandatory letters and vowels of either ink color. This is a mask convention, not certified linguistic ownership.
policy.include_optional: Include all explicitly optional pixels within each reviewed partition; already excluded neighboring words and signs stay excluded.
policy.all_ownership: Pass only if every subset between the nonempty mandatory and possible masks passes both horizontal edges, the original line rule and unchanged 12px tolerance. Abstentions remain failures; physical unavailable slots stay separate.

caveat: Same-reader post-exposure policy sensitivity, conditional on the prior manual partitions and ownership masks. Full mark ownership and exact edges may remain uncertain even when every allowed edge passes. No change to OCR geometry, acceptance, center results, original annotations or fresh-validation report.
